apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.36.6 - WHICH PRAYER POINTS ARE MERGED, SORTABLE TABLES (and Website Update 80)
  - Meetings… → Prayer groups: "Which points go together…" lets the secretary choose the group of each prayer point (points with the
    same group are put together). The number of groups can be changed the same way as before, then Make new groups.
  - Meetings… → Take attendance, Setup (kinds of meeting, each member's prayer category) and History: click a column heading to
    sort the table by it (click again for the other way).
  - The member portal does the same (Ministry → Meetings → Prayer groups: Number of groups, and the group of each point).
  - This program's copy of the portal page: Website Update 80 (rules version 47, unchanged).
